summary: POV and tense never slip and the reframing of the opening footprints as the guardian's own trail is a real payoff, but the session is pathologically repetitive - the same three-source voice formula, the same chamber-swallows-your-words opener and the same lock/seal/key litany recur in almost every turn; note also that the model forces NPC dialogue into past tense, which the card never asked for and which no rubric label covers.
